1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 c6 4.e3 f5 5.g4.strategy: Hits the f5 pawn at once to break up the pawn wall. If Black takes, the queen can retake on g4, so no pawn is lost, but the queen is out early and White's own kingside has lost its pawn cover; Black can simply develop and take advantage.
1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 c6 4.e3 f5 5.g4.name: Semi-Slav Defence: Anti-Noteboom, Stonewall Variation, Portisch Gambit
